Markéta Vondroušová ( Czech: [ˈmarkɛːta ˈvondrouʃovaː] ; born 28 June 1999) is a Czech professional tennis player. She has been ranked world No. 6 in singles by the WTA . Vondroušová has won three WTA Tour -level singles titles, including the 2023 Wimbledon Championships . She is the first unseeded player to win the Wimbledon women's singles title. [ 2 ] [ 3 ] [ 4 ] She was also runner-up at the 2019 French Open , and claimed a silver medal at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics . Vondroušová is a former junior world No. 1, having won two major doubles titles. She had a quick breakthrough on the WTA Tour , winning the 2017 Ladies Open Biel Bienne at age 17 in just her second career WTA Tour singles event.
